events.title: Retromine Next Fest Demo Announcement!
events.summary: Retromine is available during Steam Next Fest this week, the biggest demo event of the year!Thank you so much for all of your positive feedback on v5.0, and for all the comments, posts, & bug reports. I'm feeling very motivated again, and I'm getting ready to finish the game for you all in early 2027.I hope you all have a great time trying out demos during Next Fest!⛏️ Play here:

events.title: Retromine Demo 4.0 Hotfix Patch

events.summary: Hey everyone! The official Steam demo trailer for Retromine is out now! Unlock powerful passive abilities, battle against boss rounds, & dig deeper than ever before when the Retromine Steam demo launches on July 20th! Plus, check out the new trailer, new screenshots, & spoilers for new content on the brand new Steam page, also out now!
